title: feat(fields): the line-item grid's select and date cells open their panel under the cell (#36023 S5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuX9rbasSuwPhyBLwnMJDj4K)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXrmZgxib5C1kX7vnD

Part of #36023 (slice S5: the form's line-item grid. S3 and S4 change the list grid in their own pull requests; `Fixes #36023` goes on whichever of S4/S5 lands last.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 表单里的明细表照旧「点格子就打字」，回车仍是下移、最后一行回车加一行（Sales 09:40Z 裁定写明明细表不跟主列表的回车改动）。
- 单选格：格子里显示选项文字；点一下、回车、空格或直接打一个字，就在格子下面弹出可搜索的选项列表（打的那个字直接当搜索词），选一项即填好并收起。Esc 收起不改。
- 日期、日期时间格：格子里仍是原来的输入框，可以直接键入数字，录单速度不变；进入格子就在下面弹出日历，底部有「今天、明天、下周、清空」，点一天即填好，焦点留在格子里。日期时间改日子时保留原来的时刻。
- 文字格：内容比列宽时，聚焦期间输入框向右浮在旁边格子上面，不挤列宽。
- Esc：只撤回这一格这次的改动（整行回到进格子时的样子），不会把表单所在的对话框关掉、丢掉整张表。弹出面板开着时，Esc 只收面板。
- 「不存在的日子」的红字说明不再画在格子下面撑高行，改在日历顶部和格子的悬停提示里（读屏仍读得到）。
- 行高在所有情况下不变。关联记录格这次没动，等 S3 的关联可搜索列表合入后再接。

## What changes

`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/` only:

- **New `gridCellPanels.tsx`** (not on the package entry):
  - `GridSelectCell` — a flat `role="combobox"` button showing the option label; a click, Enter, Space, F2, Alt+ArrowDown or a typed character opens a Radix popover under the cell (`align="start"`, at least the cell's width) holding the existing `InCellOptionList`. A pick calls the grid's `setCell` and closes; Esc is the popover's (closes, writes nothing); Tab inside the panel closes it and focuses the next tabbable control in the table (the panel is portaled out of the table, so the browser's own order would leave it). ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the closed cell go to the grid's line navigation, as from an input.
  - `GridDateCell` — the native `date` / `datetime-local` input stays in the cell (the browser's own picker button is hidden) and is the popover's trigger; the calendar opens on focus or click with `onOpenAutoFocus` prevented, so the caret stays in the cell and typing is unchanged. A day or quick pick (Today, Tomorrow, Next week = today + 7, ruling of record 7057128455, Clear) writes the native-shaped value through the grid's `setCell` (so `datetime` still goes through `fromDateTimeInputValue`), keeps a date-time's `HH:mm`, closes, and hands the focus back to the cell in `onCloseAutoFocus` (react-day-picker focuses the clicked day after `onSelect`, so a refocus inside the pick handler was lost). Leaving the cell closes the calendar unless the focus went into it.
  - `GrowingCellInput` — a text cell's input: while focused and `scrollWidth` exceeds the cell, it is drawn absolutely over the neighbours, up to the grid's scroll box (`data-line-items-scroll`), with a spacer holding the cell's height. Its width is a measured value, the one inline style.
- **`GridField.tsx`**: `select` → `GridSelectCell` (replaces the Radix `Select`); `date` / `datetime` → `GridDateCell`; `text` → `GrowingCellInput`; `number` / `currency` / `time` keep their inputs. The cell control class is shared as `GRID_CELL_CONTROL_CLASS` (same utilities as before). The impossible-day notice keeps its element, id, test id and `aria-describedby` link, now `sr-only` in the cell, and is drawn visibly at the top of the calendar and as the cell's `title`.
- **Esc** (`GridField.tsx`): entering a cell snapshots its line (`onFocus` on the table, keyed by the new `data-grid-cell="row:column"` on each `td`; a move into the cell's own portaled panel is still the same visit). A window **capture-phase** `keydown` listener, mounted only on an editable grid, takes an Esc whose target is inside a cell: if the cell holds an open panel (`aria-expanded="true"`) it lets the panel have it; otherwise it stops the event and, if the line changed since the cell was entered, puts the snapshot back (its untouched-new-line mark and any lookup autofill included). The capture phase on `window` is what runs ahead of a Radix `Dialog`'s own document-level Escape listener, so Esc in a cell never closes the dialog the form is open in. The snapshot is held by line index, so adding, removing, duplicating or moving a line ends the visit (the row's Delete / Duplicate buttons sit inside the table, so focus on them would otherwise keep it), and the line count kept with the snapshot refuses a restore after a host replaced the lines (L1-b M1, 7061619015).
- **`InCellOptionList.tsx`**: one optional prop, `initialQuery`, the search text the list opens with (the active row starts on the first match). Not on the package entry; the list grid's callers pass nothing and are unchanged.

Docs: `ui/packages/fields/README.md` (Cell panels in line-item grids) and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` (Editing in the line-item grid). Changeset `.changeset/36023-line-grid-cell-panels.md` (`@object-ui/fields` patch).

## Why

Card #36023 item 8 asks the form's line-item grid to follow the same cell-edit rules as the list. The seat's claim (comment 7060659968, plan A, after a review of the A/B fork) reads that for this grid as the look and the panel types, not select-first editing: the line grid is a typing-first data-entry grid, and Sales' 09:40Z ruling (comment 7060745834) keeps its Enter as move down / add a line. So: panels under the cell for the choice types, the row's height never changes, long text floats right, and Esc takes back only the cell.

Clause-② measured `no` (the claim expected `yes`): no export of `@object-ui/fields` changes (`gridCellPanels.tsx` is not on the entry, and `InCellOptionList`'s new `initialQuery` prop is not on the entry either; `GridFieldProps` is unchanged), no i18n key is added (the panel reuses `fields.datePicker.*`), and nothing a metadata author writes changes.

## Verification

- New top-level `describe('cell faces that open under the cell (objectstack#36023)')` in `GridField.test.tsx` (14 cases): select label shown; click opens the panel, the cell keeps its label, typing filters, a pick writes and closes; a typed letter opens with that search and Enter picks the match; Esc in the list writes nothing; Tab in the list moves to the next cell; ArrowDown on a closed select cell moves lines; the date cell stays `type="date"`, opens its calendar on focus and still takes typed values; a calendar day writes, closes and keeps the focus in the cell; Clear and Today; a date-time day keeps 09:45; Enter in a date cell still moves down; Esc takes back the cell and only that line; Esc keeps a new line's untouched mark; inside a Radix `Dialog`, Esc in a cell (twice) never calls `onOpenChange` and an open calendar takes the Esc itself; CONTROL: Esc on a control outside the grid still closes the dialog. After L1-b's M1 (fbbaaa99): no stale line is written after the visited line is removed by its own button, after a line above is removed, or after a line above is duplicated, each followed by a return to the same cell and Esc; a new visit after the change still takes back its own edit; and in a date cell the first Esc closes the calendar and the second takes back the typed day. Without the fix the four structure cases fail (measured).
- At fbbaaa99: `GridField.test.tsx` 90 passed; the 160 test files under `ui/` naming `GridField`, `LineItemsField`, `line-items`, `MasterDetailForm`, `LineItemsPanel` or `RecordBodyTableEditor` 3,553 passed, 0 failed; `tsc --noEmit -p packages/fields` clean; no lint warning on a changed line.
- Local runs on the code of `de846e7e` (the two later commits are docs and the changeset): `GridField.test.tsx` 85 passed; every test file under `ui/` that names `GridField`, `LineItemsField`, `line-items`, `MasterDetailForm`, `LineItemsPanel` or `RecordBodyTableEditor` (140 files) 3,325 passed, 0 failed; the existing date suites (`GridField.*`, `DateField.impossibleDay-10567`, `DateTimeField.impossibleDay-10474`, `complex-widgets`, `display-grid-host-channels-e2e`) 325 passed. `tsc --noEmit -p packages/fields` clean. ESLint: no errors on the four touched files; no warning on an added line.
- Browser, 2026-11-21 10:15–10:35Z, showcase on this branch, Chromium at 1280 and 375 (full record in the seat's `build-seat1/36023/S5/evidence.md`, screenshots beside it):
  - **Record page edit state** (Expense Report → Expense Lines): a select cell's panel opens at the cell's bottom edge (top 437 / cell bottom 438 at 1280; at 375 it shifts left to stay on screen); Esc with the panel open closes only the panel and the page stays in edit; typing `ap` then Enter on Line Status picks Approved; the date-time calendar opens under the cell (above it at 375, no room below), Tomorrow moves 11-19T08:05 to 11-22T08:05 and the focus stays in the cell; a long Merchant floats to 509px over a 180px cell, shown from its first letter (at 375 capped at the grid's box); Esc in that cell puts back "Hilton Garden Inn" and keeps the other line's change; Enter on the last line still adds a line (2 → 3).
  - **Form** (Create Expense Report dialog): Esc in a typed cell empties it and the dialog stays open; Tab from Merchant reaches the Category cell, Enter opens it, ArrowDown + Enter picks; Esc after the pick puts back the default (Other) only; the date-time cell takes `11202026` / `0930A` from the keyboard with the calendar open (2026-11-20T09:30). Same at 375.
  - **Studio** draws no line-item grid: Data → Records, Form (Layout and Preview) and Add record hold no `[data-line-items-scroll]`, and outside `fields/` the grid is reached only from the record page (`RecordDetailView` / `recordEditState`) and `MasterDetailForm`. Studio's metadata repeater with `widget: 'grid'` is SchemaForm's own table and is not touched here.
  - The first read, on the packaged build of f46f745e, found two faults, fixed in 99536b01: the floated text kept the narrow cell's scroll (first letters clipped), and the calendar sat left in a panel the shortcut row widened. `GrowingCellInput` now measures the text at zero width, adds the far padding and borders, tops up once what still overflows, and resets the scroll when it all fits.

## Acceptance notes

- **Lookup cells are unchanged** in this pull request: their searchable-list face is S3's `LookupField` work; this grid picks it up after S3 lands.
- **Time cells keep the browser's own control** (already flat and typed into); the card's acceptance list names no time-cell panel.
- Column types: the spec's `InlineGridColumnSchema.type` has nine values, so the card's checkbox, rating, multi-select, tags, people, colour, long text, address and rich text faces do not exist in this grid. Adding them is a contract change and a separate card (seat).
- Esc on an unchanged cell is also kept from the dialog: leaving a form dialog by keyboard is Esc from outside the grid or the dialog's close button.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
